shinimodori:whisper-erased: The letters go, one at a time, and the board is clean.
shinimodori:whisper-authority: Something behind you moves when you do.
shinimodori:whisper-deaths-10: Ten. She is keeping count, even if you are not.
shinimodori:whisper-deaths-25: Twenty-five. You have started to recognise the ceiling.
shinimodori:whisper-deaths-50: Fifty. There is a version of you that stopped at one.
shinimodori:whisper-deaths-100: A hundred. You are not the same person who arrived here.
shinimodori:anchor-explicit: Something settles. A point you could return to.
shinimodori:trader-refuses: They step back before you finish speaking. "You smell of something I want no part of."
shinimodori:tea-choice-speak: Say the thing you cannot say.
shinimodori:tea-closing: The white comes up around the edges of the table.
shinimodori:tea-freetext-hint: Say it. Here, nothing happens to you for saying it.
shinimodori:tea-greet-first:
Oh. There you are.

Sit. You needn't do anything about the chair, it's already the right height — I made it that way when I heard you coming. I have been looking forward to this for a length of time I would rather not put a number on.

You don't know me. That's quite all right. I know you thoroughly.
shinimodori:tea-greet-again-1:
Back again. Sit, sit.

I have been reading while you were out. You are not a short book.
shinimodori:tea-greet-again-2: You look terrible. I mean that kindly — it means something happened, and things happening is the whole reason I keep the kettle on.
shinimodori:tea-greet-again-3:
There's the sound of you arriving. I have come to know it rather well.

Sit down before you fall down. The floor here is only a courtesy.
shinimodori:tea-greet-again-4:
Again? Already?

I'm not scolding. I'm delighted. Those are easy to confuse in me.
shinimodori:tea-greet-again-5:
You have that face on. The one from just before you decide to try it a different way.

Sit. Tell me the different way.
shinimodori:tea-greet-again-6: Come in, come in. Mind the flowers, they don't mind you.
shinimodori:tea-recital-none: Nothing yet, at this particular point of yours. Give it an hour.
shinimodori:tea-recital:
{0} times, at this same point. {1}.

You are becoming a very good vintage.
shinimodori:tea-speak-invite:
Go on.

You have it pressed up behind your teeth, I can see the shape of it. Out here it costs you nothing. No hand, no grey, no one going quiet and cold on the floor beside you.

I already know. That's rather the point of me.
shinimodori:tea-lore-1: There was a Witch. There is some disagreement about whether that's past tense.
shinimodori:tea-lore-2: She loved something once, and the world has been apologising for it ever since. Badly.
shinimodori:tea-lore-3: What follows you isn't a punishment. Punishments are aimed. This is closer to a smell.
shinimodori:tea-lore-4: You have wondered why it's always the same point you come back to. So have I. I have a theory. I am not going to tell you the theory.
shinimodori:tea-lore-5: She is not cruel. I want you to understand that, because it is worse. Cruelty can be reasoned with.
shinimodori:tea-lore-6: Six of us sat at tables like this. Only one of us is still pouring.
shinimodori:tea-lore-7: The hand on your heart is hers. The grey is hers. The silence afterward, where you decide whether to try again — that part is entirely yours.
shinimodori:tea-lore-8: You want to know if it ends. Everything ends. You're asking whether you'll be there for it, which is a different question, and a better one.
shinimodori:tea-reply-taboo-1:
There. Nothing happened. No grey, no cold, nothing closing around anything.

Say it again if you like. You have said it {0} times' worth of nothing, and I have enjoyed every one.
shinimodori:tea-reply-taboo-2:
Mm. I've heard you shape that sentence before, out there, where it would have cost you. Out there you got as far as the second word.

Here you got all of it. How does that sit?
shinimodori:tea-reply-taboo-3:
Say it slower.

That's not a test. I simply want it to last longer than the ones you swallow.
shinimodori:tea-reply-taboo-4:
{0} deaths, and this is the first time you've managed the whole sentence out loud.

I'm not laughing at you. I'm pleased. They look similar on me.
shinimodori:tea-reply-taboo-5:
You flinched at the end. You were waiting for the hand.

It isn't coming. Not here. Take the moment — you get so few of them.
shinimodori:tea-reply-plain-1:
Is that what you want to spend it on?

You may say the other thing. That's why the table is here.
shinimodori:tea-reply-plain-2: Mm. Go on, then. I have nowhere I would rather be, and I mean that with only a little menace.
shinimodori:tea-reply-plain-3:
You're circling. {1} times at this point and you're still circling.

I don't mind. I've been circling for considerably longer.
shinimodori:tea-reply-plain-4: The scent on you is up to {2}, by the way. I mention it the way one mentions rain.
shinimodori:tea-gift-clarity: Clarity — what took you, and where.
shinimodori:tea-gift-foresight: Foresight — see what is waiting, for a little while.
shinimodori:tea-gift-endurance: Endurance — come back without the ache, once.
shinimodori:tea-drink-clarity:
She pours, and watches your face rather than the cup.

"There. Now you know exactly where you were standing. Knowing where you were standing has never once been enough, but people do love to have it."
shinimodori:tea-drink-foresight:
It tastes like the inside of a held breath.

"For a few minutes, on the other side, the things that want you will be outlined for you. Do try to use it on something other than running away. Running away is a solved problem."
shinimodori:tea-drink-endurance:
"The next one won't ache after. Only the next one."

She sets the cup down very precisely. "You understand that I am not being kind. I am curious what you do with a body that isn't complaining."
shinimodori:tea-refuse-1:
She sits back, and for a moment she looks genuinely happy.

"No. Good. Everyone drinks it."
shinimodori:tea-refuse-2:
"No?"

She turns the cup a quarter-turn and leaves it there. "Do you know how rare that is? I have brewed considerably better than this for considerably worse people, and they all drank."
shinimodori:tea-refuse-3:
"You're learning that the things I hand you have a shape on the far side."

She smiles. "That took you fewer deaths than most."
shinimodori:tea-refuse-gift:
She looks at you for a long moment, and then does something she has not done before: she tells you something useful, for nothing.

"The point you keep coming back to. It will move when you have had {0} — not before. Now you know, and knowing will make the waiting worse. That is my gift. I did warn you about my gifts."
shinimodori:tea-farewell-1:
"Go on, then. Do it better."

She does not say goodbye. The white takes the edges of the table first.
shinimodori:tea-farewell-2:
"I'll leave the kettle."

She is already looking at the next page of you.
shinimodori:tea-farewell-3: "Try to remember that this part was pleasant. You will need something to put against the rest of it."
shinimodori:tea-farewell-4:
"One more thing."

You wait. She smiles and says nothing at all, and the field goes white.
shinimodori:tea-farewell-5: "You won't remember this the way you remember the dying. That's a mercy and a theft, and I've never worked out the ratio."
shinimodori:tea-farewell-6: "Off you go. I'd wish you luck, but I'd rather see what you do without it."
shinimodori:witch-minerva-greeting:
She is already shouting before the white has finished resolving.

"WHO. Who did this. {0} times? {0} TIMES and nobody has — "

The punch lands somewhere between your shoulder and the horizon. It does not hurt. Everything else stops hurting with it.
shinimodori:witch-minerva-speak: "Don't TALK, you're BLEEDING — " You are not bleeding. She is not listening.
shinimodori:witch-minerva-witch: "I don't care about her. I care that you're hurt. Those aren't the same subject and I refuse to pretend they are."
shinimodori:witch-typhon-greeting:
A child is sitting in Echidna's chair, feet nowhere near the floor.

"Are you a bad person?"

She asks it the way you'd ask about the weather. She will believe whatever you say. That is the problem.
shinimodori:witch-typhon-speak: "That's not an answer to my question."
shinimodori:witch-typhon-witch: "She's sad. Everyone's sad about her. Nobody's sad about the people she — " She stops. "Are you a bad person?"
shinimodori:witch-daphne-greeting:
Something is being eaten enthusiastically behind a blindfold.

"Oh! Oh, you're the {0}-deaths one! Here — " She holds out food. The food is looking at you.
shinimodori:witch-daphne-speak: "Mmf. Go on. I'm listening. I'm mostly eating, but I'm listening."
shinimodori:witch-daphne-witch: "Hungry. That's all any of us were, really. Different hungers."
shinimodori:witch-sekhmet-greeting: She is there. She does not get up. After a while you understand that this is the entire meeting, and that it is not an insult.
shinimodori:witch-sekhmet-speak: She listens to all of it. She does not respond. It is, somehow, the best conversation you have had in weeks.
shinimodori:witch-carmilla-greeting:
"You poor thing. Let me give you something."

She is very kind about it. That is how you know.
shinimodori:witch-carmilla-speak: "Of course. Of course. Say all of it." She is not listening to the words.
shinimodori:witch-carmilla-witch: "Love is the worst thing that can happen to a person, and she got the largest dose anyone ever has."
shinimodori:itemdesc-shard-of-envy: Obsidian-black, and slightly warm. Holding it feels like being recognised.
shinimodori:itemdesc-mabeast-pelt: The fur does not lie flat in any direction.
shinimodori:itemdesc-mabeast-cloak: Wearing it, the scent is harder to follow. Not gone. Harder.
shinimodori:itemdesc-witch-factor: It is not an object. It is being treated as one for your convenience.
shinimodori:shard-inert: The shard is warm, and nothing happens. Whatever it was for, it is not for this world.
shinimodori:shard-already: The shard goes cold in your hand. You already have what it was carrying.
shinimodori:shard-refused: The shard will not open for you. Someone else is already carrying this.
shinimodori:factor-already: You already have her attention. You do not need more of it.
